article.headline: Adebayo becomes Heat franchise double-double leader in 106-90 win over Wizards
article.description: — Bam Adebayo had 19 points and 15 rebounds to break Miami's franchise record for double-doubles, and the Heat cruised to a 106-90 victory over the NBA-worst Washington Wizards on Monday night.
article.linkText: Adebayo becomes Heat franchise double-double leader in 106-90 win over Wizards

images.name: Washington Wizards vs. Miami Heat: Game Highlights
images.caption: Washington Wizards vs. Miami Heat: Game Highlights

article.story: MIAMI -- — Bam Adebayo had 19 points and 15 rebounds to break Miami's franchise record for double-doubles, and the Heat cruised to a 106-90 victory over the NBA-worst Washington Wizards on Monday night. Adebayo, in his eighth season with Miami, reached the milestone with a rebound late in the second quarter. He has 222 double-doubles, one more than Rony Seikaly had in six seasons from 1988-94. Wizards rookie Kyshawn George left with a jaw injury in the fourth quarter after taking an inadvertent elbow from Adebayo. Duncan Robinson scored 17 points, and Tyler Herro and Pelle Larsson had 16 apiece for the Heat, who have won three of four. Miami is seventh in the Eastern Conference and is seeking to make a push for a guaranteed playoff spot. Khris Middleton led Washington with 16 points and Bub Carrington scored 14. Takeaways The Heat are 8-14 over their last 22 games. Key moment Herro's 3-pointer with 2:21 left in the second quarter capped a 14-3 run that put Miami ahead 50-31, and the Heat were rarely challenged from there. Key stat The Heat shot a pedestrian 47.6% from the field but held the Wizards to 36.9%. Up next Wizards: Host Utah on Wednesday. Heat: At Cleveland on Wednesday. ------ AP NBA: https://apnews.com/hub/nba ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
